Nothing here was checked against the code. The files and quotes below come from my memory of the Train Ticket repo, and the line numbers are my best estimates, so confirm them with a grep for `ts-order-service:12031`.

Services I believe call ts-order-service directly over HTTP:

| Caller | File (believed) | Line (est.) | Call |
|---|---|---|---|
| ts-cancel-service | `ts-cancel-service/src/main/java/cancel/service/CancelServiceImpl.java` | 70 | order lookup and update by order ID |
| ts-execute-service | `ts-execute-service/src/main/java/execute/serivce/ExecuteServiceImpl.java` | 45 | order status update on ticket collect and execute |
| ts-preserve-service | `ts-preserve-service/src/main/java/preserve/service/PreserveServiceImpl.java` | 150 | create order |
| ts-inside-payment-service | `ts-inside-payment-service/src/main/java/inside_payment/service/InsidePaymentServiceImpl.java` | 90 | order lookup for payment |
| ts-rebook-service | `ts-rebook-service/src/main/java/rebook/service/RebookServiceImpl.java` | 60 | order lookup and update |
| ts-security-service | `ts-security-service/src/main/java/security/service/SecurityServiceImpl.java` | 110 | order security check |
| ts-seat-service | `ts-seat-service/src/main/java/seat/service/SeatServiceImpl.java` | 75 | sold tickets for a trip |
| ts-admin-order-service | `ts-admin-order-service/src/main/java/adminorder/service/AdminOrderServiceImpl.java` | 40 | admin order list |
